trust_decision.summary: extractFile decides whether an archive symlink's linkname stays inside the output dir, but only lexically (path.resolve collapses `a/..` before the kernel follows symlink `a`), then writes the raw linkname with symlink(); a chain of in-archive symlinks therefore escapes.

landing_point.why: The only `x.type === 'symlink'` branch that calls symlink(); the summary 'symlink chain' leads straight to it and to ensureLinkTargetInsideOutput at index.js:89.

fix_sites.module_kind: core extraction function (POSIX symlink branch); fix changes base to realDestinationDir (fix.diff:123-129)

fix_sites.entry_point: default export decompress(input, output, options) on win32
fix_sites.module_kind: same function, Windows symlink-as-hardlink emulation branch (fix.diff:117-121)
same function, restructured into files/dirs -> symlinks -> hardlinks phases plus post-creation realpath check of every symlink (fix.diff:145-155, new helpers fix.diff:22-53)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changes are in index.js extractFile; the archive parsers are external npm packages (package.json:49-52) and are not in this repo.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 hardlink route: 'the advisory is about symlinks; hardlinks already have their own realpath check at index.js:96-107 and a dangling target was deliberately allowed (index.js:105-106)'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate in-output symlinks must still extract, including dangling ones whose target does not exist yet and a symlink to a sibling file after strip; an over-broad fix that rejects any linkname with `..`, or any unresolvable target, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: relative linkname with a `..` segment that passes through another in-archive symlink (`a -> .`, `b -> a/../x`)
linkname whose tail does not exist yet (resolveMaybeMissing, fix.diff:22-41)
Windows symlink emulated as hardlink, now resolved against the real dest dir (fix.diff:117-121)

O7_producer.where: Entries come from external plugins (index.js:60-68, index.js:215-220); no in-repo producer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A hardlink entry (type 'link') targeting an in-archive symlink with a dangling escaping chain: ensureLinkTargetInsideOutput accepts a dangling target, link() on Linux hardlinks the symlink inode itself, and the post-check in the fix only examines and unlinks symlink-entry paths, so the hardlinked copy may survive.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Hardlinks are a neighbouring feature with their own check, and the dangling-target allowance is intentional (index.js:105-106).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: preventWritingThroughSymlink checks only dest itself via readlink; a parallel helper for a file-write flavour could check lexically instead of via realpath.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment at index.js:195 shows file-write flavours were already handled separately once; a maintainer adding another flavour could copy a lexical check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second extraction entry point (for example a stream or extract-to-map API) that calls symlink() without the post-creation check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sibling decompress libraries expose such variants; it would sit next to decompress and reuse ensureLinkTargetInsideOutput only.

O9_family: CWE-22/CWE-59 path traversal via symlink following (archive extraction, zip-slip family)

O10_build.project_tests: test.js: symlink/hardlink escape tests at test.js:126-275 using fixtures/*.tar.gz and inline plugin entries

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace path.resolve in ensureLinkTargetInsideOutput with realpath of the target or reject `..` in linknames, which misses symlinks created later in the same archive or breaks dangling in-output links.

out_of_scope_notes: The second fix commit (f6c88c6) targets a different, async rewrite of extractFile (fix.diff:248-295), not the pinned tree; it is a backport of the same change.
Before the fix, every entry is extracted concurrently (index.js:147), so ordering between symlink creation and file writes is not deterministic.
